description: This file defines the EmployeeWorkExperienceDao class, which manages data access operations for employee work experience entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, searching, and deleting employee work experience records, utilizing Doctrine ORM query builders and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceDao
classes.description: Data access object class for performing CRUD operations and searches on employee work experience entities.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Saves or updates an EmpWorkExperience entity, assigning a sequence number if not set, with validation.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkExperienceById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific work experience record for an employee by employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingEmpWorkExperienceIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches all sequence IDs for a specific employee from a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeWorkExperiences
methods.description: Deletes specified work experience records for an employee using their sequence IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Performs a search for employee work experience records based on filter parameters, returning the results via pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencePaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for searching employee work experiences based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee work experience records matching search filters.
